Challenges

What’s holding back your website’s SEO performance?

“Why are my SEO efforts not improving rankings, traffic or leads?”

Because effort is usually aimed at the wrong problems. The audit ranks every issue by impact, so work starts where movement is.

“Which technical issues are stopping Google from crawling or indexing my pages?”

We compare crawl data with index coverage and log files to name the exact blockers — robots rules, canonicals, architecture or budget waste.

“Why are my important pages not ranking despite having content?”

Intent mismatch, cannibalisation and weak internal authority are the usual trio. The audit maps each key page to its specific cause.

“Are speed, mobile usability or Core Web Vitals hurting performance?”

We report lab and field data per template, so you see exactly which pages fail, why, and what fixing them is worth.

“Are my titles, headings, content and internal links aligned with intent?”

Every key page is checked against the search it targets — titles, headings, content depth and the links that support it.

“Is my backlink profile helping my authority or damaging it?”

A full toxicity screen plus competitor comparison: what to keep, what to recover, what to disavow.

“Are my analytics and conversion tracking showing the right data?”

We sanity-check GA4, Search Console and event tracking — decisions are only as good as the data behind them.

“Is my website ready for AI Overviews and answer-led search?”

AI readiness is a dedicated audit section: structure, entity signals and citability, with the gaps listed plainly.

Our Process

Our comprehensive SEO audit process

1

Discovery & baseline review

Goals, history and current performance documented — the baseline every finding is judged against.

2

Competitor & keyword gap audit

Where rivals win, which keywords you should own, and what their sites do that yours doesn’t.

3

Crawlability, indexation & architecture audit

Crawl budget, index coverage, URL structure and internal linking examined end to end.

4

Technical performance & mobile audit

Speed, Core Web Vitals, rendering and the mobile experience measured per template.

5

On-page, content & media audit

Titles, headings, content quality, cannibalisation and media optimisation reviewed page by page.

6

Structured data & AI readiness audit

Schema validity, rich-result eligibility and how AI platforms read your site.

7

Backlink, local & off-page authority audit

Profile quality and toxicity, citations and local signals where they apply.

8

Analytics, CRO & the priority roadmap

Tracking verified, conversion leaks noted, and everything sequenced into your 90-day action plan.

SEO Growth

How an SEO audit turns website issues into growth opportunities

Whether you are starting SEO, switching agencies or diagnosing a traffic drop, an audit is the honest starting point. Ours examines your site the way search engines and competitors see it.

Every finding comes with impact, effort and a recommended fix — so you can hand the plan to your developers, your in-house team, or us, and know the order to work in.

What you get from your SEO audit

Everything a decision needs, in one report:

  • The full audit report — document and spreadsheet versions
  • Every issue rated by severity and revenue impact
  • A prioritised 90-day action roadmap
  • Core Web Vitals & performance report
  • AI and answer-engine readiness findings
  • Executive summary & a walkthrough call

How the fixes get done

Two routes, your choice. Take the audit and roadmap and have your own team implement it — the tickets are developer-ready. Or have us implement it: the same specialists who found the issues fix them, and the re-audit confirms the lift.

How long an audit takes

Most audits are delivered within 5–10 business days depending on site size — a brochure site and a large catalogue are different jobs. Your proposal confirms the exact timeline before any work starts.

From findings to real growth

An audit is the starting line, not the finish. The roadmap sequences fixes by impact, and most clients roll straight into a growth program where the same team executes the plan and reports the recovery in rankings, traffic and revenue.

The Audit Checklist

What our SEO audit package includes

Tools gather the data; a senior specialist reviews every finding and ranks it. Whether you are starting SEO, switching agencies or diagnosing a traffic drop, this is the honest starting point.

Crawl & indexation

  • Full-site crawl and URL inventory
  • Index coverage vs. crawl comparison
  • Crawl budget and wasted-crawl analysis
  • Orphan and dead-end page detection
  • Redirect chains, loops and status-code errors
  • Server log review (bot behaviour)
  • Soft-404 and thin-error-page detection
  • Pagination and infinite-scroll handling

Robots & sitemaps

  • robots.txt rules and accidental blocks
  • XML sitemap accuracy and hygiene
  • HTML sitemap and internal discovery paths
  • Canonical tag correctness
  • Noindex/nofollow usage audit
  • Parameter and faceted-URL handling
  • Hreflang return-tag and target checks

Site architecture

  • Click-depth and hub-page analysis
  • URL structure and folder logic
  • Breadcrumb and navigation coherence
  • Internal linking and authority flow
  • Broken internal and external links
  • Anchor-text distribution review

Content audit

  • Thin, duplicate and cannibalising pages
  • Content gaps vs. top competitors
  • Search-intent match per key page
  • E-E-A-T and trust signals
  • Content freshness and decay report
  • Internal anchor-text review
  • Keyword cannibalisation map
  • Orphan content with traffic potential

Titles & metadata

  • Title tags — length, duplication, keyword fit
  • Meta descriptions and click-through appeal
  • Heading structure (H1–H6) per template
  • Open Graph and social tags
  • Missing and duplicate metadata report
  • Pagination and canonical metadata conflicts

Structured data

  • Existing schema inventory and validation
  • Product, article, FAQ and breadcrumb eligibility
  • Rich-result opportunities by page type
  • Schema errors and deprecated markup
  • Entity and organisation markup review

Media SEO

  • Image alt text and file-name review
  • Image weight and format optimisation
  • Video discoverability and transcripts
  • Lazy-loading and layout-shift impact
  • Image sitemap completeness

Speed & Core Web Vitals

  • LCP, INP and CLS — lab and field data
  • Template-level bottleneck diagnosis
  • JavaScript rendering cost
  • Hosting and caching configuration review
  • Third-party script weight audit
  • Font-loading and render-blocking review

Mobile & rendering

  • Mobile usability and tap-target checks
  • Responsive template parity (mobile vs. desktop content)
  • JavaScript rendering — what bots actually see
  • Viewport and font-loading behaviour
  • App deep-link and interstitial checks

Links & authority

  • Backlink profile quality and toxicity screen
  • Competitor authority comparison
  • Lost and broken backlink recovery list
  • Internal authority concentration risks
  • Brand mention and citation consistency

Local SEO (where relevant)

  • Google Business Profile completeness
  • Location page quality and duplication
  • Citation accuracy across directories
  • Review profile and response patterns
  • Local schema and service-area setup

E-commerce (where relevant)

  • Faceted navigation and filter indexation
  • Out-of-stock and discontinued product handling
  • Product schema completeness
  • Category pagination and crawl traps
  • Feed-to-page data consistency

International (where relevant)

  • Hreflang implementation and reciprocity
  • Country and language targeting signals
  • Localised metadata and content parity
  • Regional duplicate-content risks
  • Currency, pricing and availability signals

Analytics & measurement

  • Analytics and Search Console configuration
  • Conversion and event tracking sanity check
  • Traffic and ranking baseline documentation
  • Reporting gaps that hide SEO performance

What your report includes

  • Every finding rated by impact and effort
  • A sequenced 90-day action plan
  • Developer-ready fix instructions
  • Walkthrough call with a senior specialist
  • Re-audit discount if we implement the plan
  • Delivery in 5–10 business days

Ready when you are — request your audit or see audit pricing.

FAQs

FAQs on SEO audit services

How long does an audit take?

Most audits are delivered within 5–10 business days depending on site size.

Is the audit automated?

Tools gather data, but every finding is reviewed and prioritised by a senior specialist — the report is written for humans.

Do we have to hire you afterwards?

No. The plan is yours to execute with any team. Many clients do ask us to implement it — that is your choice.

What do you need from us?

Search Console and analytics access (read-only is fine) and 30 minutes for a goals call.

How much does an SEO audit cost?

It is priced by site size and depth — a brochure site and a large catalogue are different jobs. Audit pricing gives the ranges upfront, and your proposal confirms the exact figure before any work starts.

What if the audit finds serious problems?

Then it has done its job. Critical issues are flagged at the top of the report with the fix sequence, and we tell you honestly what each problem is likely costing you in traffic.

How is this different from a free automated audit tool?

Free tools check a homepage against generic rules. This audit crawls the whole site, reads your logs and analytics, compares you with the competitors actually outranking you, and ranks fixes by business impact — the difference between data and a decision.

Can you audit an e-commerce or multilingual site?

Yes — catalogue structure, faceted navigation and hreflang are dedicated sections of the checklist for stores and multi-market sites.
